name: Jeeter | Watermelon ZKZ | 2G Liquid Diamond XL All-In-One Vape
description: Watermelon ZKZ bursts with juicy fruit layered over a smooth earthy finish. Sweet, mellow, and refreshing, it leaves a flavor that lingers like the last sip of a summer drink. Best enjoyed when the day clocks out and the vibes clock in.
